headline: EPS jumps year-over-year, nearly doubles q/q
summary_short: Recruit Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥145.48, up 73.3% y/y from ¥83.97.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥145.48 rose 73.3% year-over-year from ¥83.97, and nearly doubled sequentially, up 98.7% from ¥73.20 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
